question: What practice begins first when one engages the root wheel?
premises: The root wheel is the object of practice
The practice is undertaken at a certain time
This is described as the first stage
inference: The initial stage of practice involves engaging the root wheel.
uncertainties: The sandhi and segmentation in yadānyabhyasate are compressed in the given token.
plain_english: O beloved, when one first practices upon the root wheel.
